intents: Finish the simple three-node line so pc1 and pc2 can reach each other through r1.
pc1 is already prepared on 10.0.1.2/24 and points traffic for pc2's subnet at 10.0.1.1.
pc2 is already prepared on 10.0.2.2/24 and points traffic for pc1's subnet at 10.0.2.1.
Configure r1 as the router between the two LANs, using 10.0.1.1/24 toward pc1 and 10.0.2.1/24 toward pc2.
ground_truth_reasoning: The endpoints already have IPv4 addresses and static routes pointing at r1. r1 is missing the two gateway addresses and kernel forwarding. Assigning 10.0.1.1/24 on eth1 and 10.0.2.1/24 on eth2 makes r1 directly connected to both LANs; enabling IPv4 forwarding lets the kernel route packets between them while leaving eth0 management untouched.
